greeting: Final Guardian Apex on comms. Stage 4: The Penultimate Step. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Ascent. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Battle Apex to prove final readiness.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Battle Apex to prove final readiness; Demonstrate understanding of the burden; Earn the right to face the Maker. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Face the last guardian before the peak. Immediate move: Battle Apex to prove final readiness.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: The Penultimate Step. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Threshold of Creation.
rumor: Floor attendants say broken elevators still answer to old captain codes.
People keep repeating one clue from The Penultimate Step: 'Earn the right to face the Maker'.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in the tower is maintenance hour. Security patterns are predictable.
dialog.time_noon: Noon rotations overlap. Expect stacked encounters and less recovery time.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk shadowing in tower arenas hides projectile tells. Keep spacing.
dialog.time_night: Night floor clears are endurance checks. Pace your resources.

party_reactions.kade: Final Guardian Apex sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Final Guardian Apex accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Final Guardian Apex talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
